primary: equal-weight mean over all four backgrounds, each method minus same-order C; show each order and each background

bootstrap.unit: 20 physical states jointly preserving every appearance and both sampling orders

valuable_repeated_benefit_rule: method minus C background mean >0 and state-cluster CI lower bound >0 in each order; always display Clean cost and absolute SR
if_no_reliable_benefit_with_Clean_cost: archive current AE-consistency and shared-Clean-target implementations as negative results and stop tuning these implementations
if_local_or_order_dependent: describe exploratory local/order-dependent candidate only; no automatic background-specific tuning
if_repeated_benefit: propose evaluation on newly frozen independent development states, disclose Clean tradeoff; do not execute this round
